query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Wan2.2 Image to Video (Subgraph) template fails on Apple Silicon with TypeError: Float8_e4m3fn has no MPS backend support. The template ships fp8 quantized weights, which macOS/MPS cannot execute - platform limitation, not a workflow wiring error.

desired.outcome: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) gave the definitive cause: macOS does not support Float8_e4m3fn model weights ('Apple just doesn't support it'); suggested trying GGUF-quantized weights, noting most open-source video models perform poorly on Mac anyway. OP accepted, said the ticket can be closed as 'force majeure'.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) gave the definitive cause: macOS does not support Float8_e4m3fn model weights ('Apple just doesn't support it'); suggested trying GGUF-quantized weights, noting most open-source video models perform poorly on Mac anyway. OP accepted, said the ticket can be closed as 'force majeure'.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Diagnose that the template's fp8 (Float8_e4m3fn) weights have no MPS backend on Apple Silicon — a platform limitation — and substitute GGUF-quantized weights.
